body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics presented its 120Hz full HD LCD TV ‘Broadway’ adopting its latest wooden bezel during KES(Korea Electronics Show) 2007. With 42-, 47-, and 52-inch panel options, the Broadway features a 178-degree viewing angle, its new XD processing engine, a HDMI connection and a USB-host jack enabling users to enjoy multimedia content such as music, photo and video.
